import io, re
from dotenv.parser import _newline, Reader
class P:
    def __init__(self, chars, line):
        self.chars=chars; self.line=line
    @classmethod
    def start(cls): return cls(0,1)
    def set(self,o): self.chars=o.chars; self.line=o.line
    def advance(self, s):
        self.chars += len(s)
        self.line += len(re.findall(_newline, s))
r=Reader(io.StringIO("X=1\r\nY=2\nZ=3\n"))
r.position = P.start()
# simulate parse through parse_stream-like loop using monkeypatch of Position
import dotenv.parser as parser
parser.Position = P
lines=[b.original.line for b in parser.parse_stream(io.StringIO("X=1\r\nY=2\nZ=3\n"))]
print("with fix:", lines)
lines2=[b.original.line for b in parser.parse_stream(io.StringIO("A=1\n\nB=2\nX=\"multi\nline\"\nY=3\r\n"))]
print("multiline:", lines2)
EOF
